need.title: The reason matters
need.text: Antibiotics are useful for certain bacterial infections. Viral infections and many other illnesses will not benefit from antibiotics. A clinician can establish whether an antibiotic is needed.

prescription.title: Check your current prescription
prescription.text: Follow the instructions given for your own prescription. Ask the prescriber or pharmacist if anything is unclear before making a change.

leftovers.title: Leftovers and sharing raise a concern
leftovers.text: Medicines kept from a previous illness or prescribed to someone else may be unsuitable and can delay appropriate care. Ask a pharmacist or prescriber what to do.

amr.title: Why appropriate use matters
amr.text: Unnecessary or inappropriate antibiotic use contributes to antimicrobial resistance. Drug-resistant infections may be more difficult to treat. Using antibiotics responsibly helps protect treatment options.

eczema.title: An eczema flare needs context
eczema.text: An eczema flare can occur without a bacterial infection. Even changes in the skin that resemble infection do not establish that an antibiotic is needed. A clinician can assess the cause and suitable care.

eczema_review.title: When symptoms change
eczema_review.text: Seek medical assessment if eczema worsens quickly or you feel very unwell. A professional should reassess symptoms that have not improved after treatment.

boil.title: A boil can need different care
boil.text: A healthcare professional can assess a boil and decide what care it needs. Antibiotics are only one possible part of treatment. An app cannot make that decision from a label.

boil_review.title: Get a professional assessment
boil_review.text: If a boil is on the face, the surrounding skin becomes painful and swollen, or you feel feverish or shivery, seek prompt medical care. Repeated boils or a boil that does not improve also warrant assessment.
boil_review.section: When to see a GP and urgent advice

interaction.title: A documented medicine interaction
interaction.text: The sildenafil label warns against taking it with nitrate medicines because the combination may cause a dangerous drop in blood pressure. A pharmacist or clinician should review the medicines promptly.

ulcer.title: A documented medical-history concern
ulcer.text: The oral diclofenac label warns that a history of stomach ulcers or gastrointestinal bleeding is associated with a higher risk of serious gut complications. A pharmacist or clinician should assess this history and review the medicine.
ulcer.section: Boxed warning; gastrointestinal bleeding, ulceration and perforation

children.title: Children need individual advice
children.text: Antibiotics can cause side effects in children. Discuss concerns or side effects with a qualified health professional, and use the instructions prescribed for the child.

nigeria_amr.title: Antibiotic stewardship in Nigeria
nigeria_amr.text: NCDC describes stewardship as improving how antimicrobials are used while reducing avoidable harms and resistance. For this example, ask a health professional whether an antibiotic is needed before starting one yourself.

uti_assessment.title: Urinary symptoms deserve an assessment
uti_assessment.text: A health professional can assess urinary symptoms and decide if testing or treatment is needed. Suspected urinary infection in a child or during pregnancy warrants prompt professional advice.
uti_assessment.section: When to seek help and treatment

pneumonia_assessment.title: Breathing difficulty needs prompt care
pneumonia_assessment.text: Pneumonia in children can have different causes and requires assessment. If a child is having difficulty breathing, seek urgent medical care.

tonsillitis_assessment.title: Sore throat can have different causes
tonsillitis_assessment.text: Tonsillitis is commonly caused by viruses and can also have a bacterial cause. A professional can assess whether antibiotics are appropriate.

typhoid_assessment.title: Fever needs proper assessment
typhoid_assessment.text: Typhoid can be serious and can be confirmed by blood testing. Seek medical care for suspected typhoid and let a professional establish what treatment is appropriate.

wound_assessment.title: A wound may require more than an antibiotic
wound_assessment.text: Seek medical assessment if a wound becomes increasingly painful, red or swollen, or has pus. A professional can assess the wound and decide what care it needs.

diarrhoea_assessment.title: Diarrhoea needs context
diarrhoea_assessment.text: Diarrhoea can have several causes. WHO advises consulting a health professional, especially if it persists, there is blood in the stool, or there are signs of dehydration. A pack label cannot establish the cause.
